name: Discerptor Eviscerus
featDescription: Models in Eviscerus' battlegroup currently in his control range become Dug In. Then, models in Eviscerus' battlegroup currently in his control range gain Burial Rites. (A dug in model has cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.) (A model with Burial Rites gains +2 SPD and one focus point at the start of each activation in which it begins Dug In. A model loses Burial Rites for the rest of the game the next time it ceases to be Dug In.)

name: Deceleration
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attack damage rolls. Deceleration lasts for one round.

name: Carrion Feast
description: Center a cloud effect template on the model directly hit. The template is a hazard and remains in play as long as upkeep is paid. While in the template, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.

name: Redline
description: Target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected warjack suffers d3 damage points.

name: Ghost Walk
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Ghostly for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

name: Occultation
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Stealth.

name: Repairable
description: This model can be targeted with Repair special actions as if it were a construct model.

name: Steady
description: This model cannot become knocked down.

name: Chop Shop
description: When a model in this model's battlegroup destroys an enemy construct model with a melee attack, remove d3 +1 damage points from one model in this model's battlegroup currently in its control range and remove the destroyed model from play.

name: Repair [d3 +1] (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +1 damage points from it.

name: Field Marshal [Retaliatory Strike]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

name: Erosion
description: This model gains an additional die on this weapon’s damage rolls against construct models.

name: Alchemical Mask
description: This model does not suffer gas effects. When determining LOS or resolving attacks, this model ignores cloud effects and concealment granted from cloud effects.

name: Smoke Bombs (★Action)
description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. This template remains in play for one round.

name: Attack Type
description: Each time this weapon is used to make an attack, choose one of the following special rules:

name: •Experimental Warhead
description: Models hit by this attack suffer the Fire and Corrosion continuous effects.

name: •Spontaneous Combustion
description: On a direct hit, add an additional die to this weapon’s damage roll if the model hit is suffering a continuous effect. Add two dice instead if the model hit is suffering from two different continuous effects. Then, all continuous effects on that model expire.

name: •Black Humor
description: This weapon gains Continuous Effect: Corrosion and Grievous Wounds for this attack. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

name: Mortenebra Perfected
featDescription: Return one destroyed large-based or smaller Cohort model that was part of Mortenebra's battlegroup to play. Place it anywhere completely within 3" of her. The Cohort model must forfeit its Combat Action this turn.

name: Admonition
description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup, the affected model can immediately advance up to 3", then Admonition expires.

name: Synergy
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in this model’s battlegroup gain a +1 cumulative bonus on melee attack and melee damage rolls for each other model in the battlegroup that hit an enemy model with a melee attack this turn while in the spellcaster’s control range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

name: Mobility
description: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder for one turn.

name: Arcantrik Bolt
description: A warjack damaged by this attack becomes stationary for one round.

name: Jumpstart
description: Shakeable effects on models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that are currently in its control range expire. Models that suffered shakeable effects this turn are not affected by Jumpstart.

name: Hellwrought
description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM and Retaliation. (If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

name: Flying High
description: Ranged attacks targeting this model suffer –3 RNG. Friendly models can advance through this model if they have enough movement to move completely past its base. This model loses Flying High if it loses Flight.

name: Repairable
description: This model can be targeted with Repair special actions as if it were a construct model.

name: Reposition [3"]
description: At the end of this model/unit’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.

name: Resourceful
description: This model can upkeep spells on models in its battlegroup without spending focus or fury points.

name: Free Fall
description: When a model with Flight is hit by this attack it becomes knocked down and loses Flight for one round.

name: Critical Smite
description: On a critical hit, the model hit can be slammed d6" directly away from this model. If the model hit has a larger base than the attacking model, it is moved only half the distance rolled. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon.

name: True Mercenary
description: This model will work for any army. You may only include one model with True Mercenary in your list during list construction.

name: Quagmire
description: While B2B with target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and cannot advance.

name: Batten Down the Hatches
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup cannot become knocked down and gain +3 ARM but suffer –2 DEF. Batten Down the Hatches lasts for one round.

name: Torment
description: When a model is damaged by Torment, for one round it loses Tough, cannot remove damage, and cannot transfer damage.

name: Lesser Warlock
description: This model is not a warlock or Leader, but has the following warlock special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Fury Manipulation, Healing, Spellcaster, and Transferring Damage. This model must have at least one warbeast in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

name: Limited Battlegroup [War Boar MMD47]
description: The only warbeast that can be in this model’s battlegroup is War Boar MMD47.

name: Hyper-Aggressive
description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

name: Both Barrels (★Attack)
description: This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack. This model cannot make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during an activation in which it makes a Both Barrels attack.

name: Critical Pitch
description: On a critical hit against a model with an equal or smaller base, the model hit can be thrown d6" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this attack.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Companion [Carver Ultimus]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Carver Ultimus. If Carver is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Carver’s battlegroup.

name: Recoil
description: The spellcaster gains Swift Hunter. Recoil lasts for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: Full Boar
description: This model can use Full Boar at the start of its activation. This model gains +2 SPD that activation. At the end of that activation, this model suffers d3 damage points. Full Boar can be used only once per activation.

name: Bulldoze
description: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

name: Exhaust Fumes
description: When this model advances during its Normal Movement, for one round other friendly models gain concealment while within 3" of this model.

name: Volume Fire
description: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon against medium-based models and +2 to attack and damage rolls against larger-based models.

name: Forced Reload [1]
description: This model can be forced once during its activation to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

name: Critical Shred
description: On a critical hit with this weapon during this model’s Combat Action, after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional attack with this weapon against the model hit.

name: Aggressive
description: This model can run or charge without spending a focus point.

name: Dig In (★Action)
description: This model gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged. It can begin the game dug in.

name: Drag Below
description: During this model's activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it boxed an enemy warrior model, this model can use Drag Below. The boxed model is removed from play and this model can immediately make a full advance and then perform a Dig In special action, then its activation ends.

name: Extended Control Range
description: When checking to see if this model is in its controller's control range, double the range.

name: Finisher
description: This model gains an additional die on damage rolls against damaged models.

name: Critical Shred
description: On a critical hit with this weapon during this model’s Combat Action, after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional attack with this weapon against the model hit.

name: Vice Clamp
description: An enemy model with an equal or smaller base hit by this weapon suffers –2 DEF and cannot advance while within this model’s melee range for one round.

name: Wraithbinder Nekane
featDescription: Nekane can suffer one damage point to cast a spell instead of paying the COST of the spell in focus points. Each spell can be cast once as a result of Wrath of Lyliss. Additionally, Nekane can suffer one damage point to boost an attack or damage roll instead of spending a focus point. Wrath of Lyliss lasts for one round.

name: Mirage
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Apparition. (During your Control Phase, place models with Apparition anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations.)

name: Banishing Ward
description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target friendly model/unit expire. Affected models cannot be targeted by enemy spells or animi.

name: Venom
description: Venom causes corrosion damage. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Crippling Grasp
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 SPD, DEF, and ARM. Additionally, an affected model suffers –2 to its melee attack damage rolls.

name: Crimson Veil
description: Target friendly Faction model's melee weapons gain Blood Shadow. (If an attack with a weapon with Blood Shadow boxes a living or undead model, this model can gain Incorporeal for one round.)

name: Wraithbinder
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Incorporeal models gain +3 ARM.

name: Grappling Hook
description: At the end this models activation, this model can spend 1 focus point to be placed completely within 5" of its current location.

name: Vital Magic
description: When a spell or special rule would cause one or more of this model’s upkeep spells to expire, this model can keep one or more of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points for each spell kept in play.

name: Dodge
description: This model can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.

name: Banish
description: When this weapon damages an enemy non-Leader model, immediately after the attack is resolved you can place the enemy model anywhere completely within 1" of its current location.

name: Blood Shadow
description: If this attack boxes a living or undead model, this model can gain Incorporeal for one round.

name: Mercenary [House Kallyss, Necrofactorium, and Sea Raiders]
description: This model will work for House Kallyss, Necrofactorium, and Sea Raiders.

name: Defensive Strike
description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in this model’s melee range, this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.

name: Hell Marked
description: Models destroyed by attacks made by this model never generate soul tokens.

name: Cleave
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional melee attack. This model can gain only one additional attack from Cleave each activation.

name: Spell Ward
description: This model cannot be targeted by spells.

name: Entropic Force
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them.

name: Life Drinker
description: When this model boxes a living enemy model with this weapon, this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: Mortal Fear
description: While within 8" of this model, living enemy models suffer –2 to damage rolls.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Marionette (★Attack)
description: Marionette is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Target enemy model/unit. You can have one affected model reroll one attack or damage roll, then Marionette expires. Marionette lasts for one round.

name: •Power of Death (★Action)
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly undead models gain +2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Power of Death lasts for one turn.

name: •Stygian Abyss (★ Attack)
description: Stygian Abyss is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. On a critical hit, the model hit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or magic attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

name: Death-Powered
description: This model gains +1 ARM and +1 to its melee attack damage rolls for each corpse token currently on it.

name: Girded
description: This model and friendly models B2B with it gain Resistance: Blast.

name: •Thrall Crafting
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend up to three corpse tokens to put one friendly Corpse Crawler into play for each token spent. You can have up to three friendly Corpse Crawlers in play at any time for each friendly Necroharvester in play. Place the Crawlers B2B with this model.

name: Steady
description: This model cannot become knocked down.

name: Sturdy
description: This model cannot be pushed.

name: Body Snatcher: Harvester
description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living or undead friendly model is destroyed by an enemy attack within 8" of this model or when a living or undead enemy model is destroyed within 8" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

name: •Death Feast
description: During its activation, this model can spend corpse tokens to remove d3 damage points for each token spent.

name: •Meat for the Beast
description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend corpse tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

name: Salvage Harvester
description: When this model destroys an enemy Cohort model with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved remove d3+3 damage points from this model.

name: Critical Grievous Wounds
description: On a critical hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.

name: Drag
description: If this model hits an enemy model with an equal or smaller base with a basic attack with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved the hit model can be pushed directly toward this model until it contacts a model, an obstacle, or an obstruction.

name: Self-Propelled
description: This model cannot forfeit its Normal Movement. When this model makes its Normal Movement, instead of moving it normally you must choose the direction it is moving. It then advances its SPD +d6 in a straight line. On a roll of 6, instead of moving this model explodes with the same effect as Explosive Decomposition and is removed from play.

name: Explosive Decomposition
description: This model explodes if it contacts an enemy model while advancing or if it becomes knocked down. When this model explodes, models within 2" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 corrosion damage roll and the Corrosion continuous effect, then this model is removed from play.

name: Created
description: This model does not begin the game in play.

name: Inconsequential
description: This model can not score or contest Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Soul Transfer (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model with a Soul Taker special rule. If the model is in range, remove any number of soul tokens from this model and place them on the target friendly model.

name: •Strength of Death
description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

name: •Invocation of Bitterest Night (★Action)
description: This model gains Stealth and Black Mantle for one round. (While B2B with a model with Black Mantle, friendly Faction models gain Stealth.)

name: •Knowledge of the Damned
description: When a model in this model’s control range makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a soul token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Knowledge of the Damned.

name: Soul Taker: Spectral Scavenger
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living model is destroyed in this model’s control range, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: •Hex Blast (★ Attack)
description: Hex Blast is a RNG 10, AOE 2, POW 13/8 arcane attack. Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Hex Blast immediately expire.

name: True Mercenary
description: This model will work for any army. You may only include one model with True Mercenary in your list during list construction.

name: Revive
description: Target one friendly trooper model. Return one destroyed Grunt model to the target model’s unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target model. The Grunt model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

name: Vision
description: When target friendly Faction model is directly hit by an attack, you can choose to have it suffer no damage roll from the attack, then Vision expires.

name: Dark Seduction
description: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. You can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. Dark Seduction can be cast only once per activation. A model can be affected by Dark Seduction only once per turn.

name: Sucker!
description: If this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of it to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Anatomical Precision
description: When this model’s melee damage roll fails to exceed the ARM of the living model hit, that model suffers 1 damage point. A model disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

name: Limited Battlegroup [Aberration]
description: The only cohort that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Aberration.

description: This terrain feature is a hazard. A model without Flight entering the area of this terrain feature suffers the Fire continuous effect. If a trooper model without Flight advances through the area of this terrain as part of its unit’s Normal Movement, all models in the unit suffer the fire continuous effect.

name: Illumination
description: Models lose Stealth while within 5" of this terrain feature.

name: Exploding!
description: This terrain feature explodes and is removed from play if an extra-large or huge-based model contacts it. This terrain feature also explodes if a model contacts it as a result of slam or throw movement. This terrain feature explodes immediately after a Throw targeting it has been resolved. This terrain feature explodes if an attack targeting it results in a critical hit. When this terrain feature explodes, all models within 2" of it suffer a POW 15 blast damage roll, and this terrain feature is removed from the table.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Targetable
description: This terrain feature can be targeted by basic ranged and melee attacks as a small-based model. This terrain feature can be targeted by attacks made by either player’s models.  This terrain feature does not suffer damage or any other effects from attacks targeting it.

name: Throwable
description: Medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality can target this terrain feature with Throw Power Attacks. This terrain feature is automatically hit by the attack. For the purposes of resolving a throw, this terrain feature is considered to be a medium-based model. This terrain feature is moved 2 additional inches when thrown. A model hit by this terrain feature when it is thrown suffers collateral damage normally.

name: Demolition
description: A medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality within 1" of this terrain feature can make a Demolition (★ Action) special action during its activation. When it does so remove this terrain feature and another Defense within 10" of it from the table.

name: Spike Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. An enemy model without Flight entering or ending its activation within 1" of this terrain feature suffers a POW 10 damage roll. If an enemy warjack without Flight enters this terrain feature, in addition to the POW 10 damage roll, the warjack also suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement System box. Your models do not suffer damage from these terrain features if you placed them.

name: Rough Terrain
description: This terrain feature is rough terrain.

name: Spike Trap
description: A Spike Trap's dimensions are 50mm square area terrain.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Cover
description: This terrain feature grants cover.

name: Barrier
description: A Barrier is 4" in length, 1/2" wide, and 3/4" tall.

name: Hit & Run
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models. That model gains Reposition [3"] this activation. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Duck and Cover!
description: Play this card at any time during the activation of one of your warrior units. Those models gain cover and Resistance: Blast for one round.

name: Lucky Penny
description: Play this card at the start of a friendly model’s activation to give that model one corpse token, essence point, focus point, fury point, rage token, or soul token.

name: Old Faithful
description: Play this card during your Control Phase before allocating focus. Remove d3+1 damage from a friendly Cohort model or battle engine in your army.

name: Put the Fires Out
description: Play this card at the start of your Maintenance Phase on one of your model/units. If the affected models were knocked down, they stand up. If the affected models were stationary, the stationary status expires. If the affected models were suffering continuous or shakable effects, like Blind or Shadow Bind, those effects expire.

name: Sapper
description: Play this card at any time during your turn. Immediately remove a Defense from the table.
